# T4 search oracle on the full AC model

Stage A: 10000 Latin hypercube samples of the full envelope (seed 2007), shared by all rules. Stage B: differential evolution per topology (16 topologies), hard budget 32000 power flows per rule split evenly, population 15 initialised by LHS, no polishing, seed 7+topology index. Margin is positive iff the rule fires, in the units set by each atom's `scale`. Non-benign states are penalised, so every reported counterexample is benign by construction; the best counterexample is also re-solved with pandapower `runpp` (last column).

| rule | counterexample found | found by stage | Stage A firing benign samples | Stage A best margin | Stage B firing evaluations | Stage B best margin | power flows | Stage A time share s | Stage B time s | time per certification s | runpp re-check of best counterexample |

Stage A time is split evenly across the rules because the samples are shared. Time per certification = Stage A share + Stage B. Measured on this container's CPU, not a laptop.

## Counterexample states

- **R1** (R1 naive threshold): Stage A best: topology `ties=S3;out=L2`; load scale min/mean/max 0.428/0.900/1.183; DER min/mean/max 0.069/0.475/0.991; vm_pu.11=0.9176. Stage B best: topology `ties=S2;out=L9`; load scale min/mean/max 0.274/0.864/1.145; DER min/mean/max 0.038/0.394/0.618; vm_pu.11=0.9000.
- **R2** (R2 context rule): Stage A best: no firing benign sample. Stage B best: topology `ties=S1;out=L10`; load scale min/mean/max 0.219/0.787/1.172; DER min/mean/max 0.001/0.344/0.764; loading.0=76.1420, linear lhs=2.8279.
- **R3** (R3 power balance violation): Stage A best: no firing benign sample. Stage B best: topology `ties=S1;out=L0`; load scale min/mean/max 0.289/1.038/1.196; DER min/mean/max 0.013/0.279/0.609; sgen_p.0=0.0011, sgen_p.1=0.0122, sgen_p.2=0.0036, sgen_p.3=0.0032, linear lhs=0.5774.
